subject: คณิตศาสตร์
level: โอลิมปิก (สอวน.)

units.title: Polynomial divisors of factorials plus a fixed offset
units.statement: For positive N,c, the integer-coefficient polynomials P with P(n) dividing n!+c for all integers n≥N are exactly the nonzero constant polynomials whose absolute values divide gcd(N!,c). Fix m≥N and choose arbitrarily large n congruent to m modulo |P(m)|. Then |P(m)| divides P(n), n!+c, and n!, so |P(m)| divides c. Thus P is bounded on all large positive integers and must be constant. The common divisors of n!+c over n≥N are precisely divisors of gcd(N!,c).
steps: Use polynomial congruence and a large factorial to show every P(m) divides c
Conclude that P is constant from bounded values
Count positive and negative divisors of gcd(N!,c)
